findings.stemStart: Entry-level Sekt Austria may be produced in tank
findings.problem: Keyed Six months, with an exp claiming six months in tank and nine in bottle. Every source on the Sekt g.U. pyramid, both the original Klassik rules and the post-rename Sekt Austria rules, gives a flat minimum of nine months on the lees for the base tier whatever the method; the six/nine split is the EU minimum production time for quality sparkling wine (tank against bottle), not the Austrian lees rule. Nine months, a distractor, was the right answer.
findings.fix: Key moved to Nine months (options unchanged, Six months now a distractor); exp rewritten: any method, tank included, but the same nine months on the lees for all.
findings.source: Three web searches (Sekt g.U. Klassik/Sekt Austria rules: Decanter and pressflex reports of the 2015 pyramid, starwinelist, napavalleywineacademy, Meininger 'Sekt Austria', WKO Sektbezeichnung notice): all give nine months for the base tier, none six; EU Reg. 2019/934 for the 6/9 production-time rule
